subject: general
question:
The following pie chart represents the total expenditure of ₹12,00.000 on several items in construction of a house in a village.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/926b3f5ead0beae10c5e1cc4e11da8cb363ad9e5377409d76b0d559bd26ae99f.png] 

The percentage of the total expenditure spent on Cement, Wood and Plastic (correct to 2 decimal places) is:
solution:
**Calculation:**

Total expenditure of Cement + Wood + Plastic = 57° + 40° + 55°

⇒ 152°

Required % = (152°/360°) × 100

⇒ 42.22%

**∴ The required answer is 42.22%.**
